# The PCH snapshot section's format record (WP-1397, spec/pch.md
# "Format versioning"): one line per snapshot format kiln has written,
# oldest first, "<FORMAT_VERSION> <SCHEMA_HASH as 16 hex digits>".
#
# The last line must be this build's crates/kiln_driver/src/pch_snapshot.rs
# FORMAT_VERSION and SCHEMA_HASH; the test
# `pch_snapshot::tests::format_record` fails otherwise and says what to do.
# When SCHEMA_HASH changes (any change of a type the snapshot reaches,
# including the list of diagnostic ids, which the diagnostics engine's
# root folds), bump FORMAT_VERSION and append a line; never edit or
# remove a line.
#
# Versions 1 (WP-1392) and 2 (WP-1403, the lookup log) predate the record,
# which starts with the schema 1.2.0 ships.
